name: Carbios Longlaville plant, Meurthe-et-Moselle

source.note: Carbios press release, 3 August 2026; details from Carbios first-half 2026 results release, 24 September 2026

notes: Status per card source: ground-breaking April 2024; construction suspended pending project financing; the financial close target of 30 September 2026 was missed and the start of production, previously expected H1 2028, is postponed; credit committee approvals obtained from the majority of lenders during summer 2026, a commercial agreement with a major beverage-industry player being finalised to raise pre-sales to about 60% of nominal capacity, and due diligence by export credit agencies and equity partners ongoing (as of 24 September 2026)
